per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 1.6 the replacement of "from the definition of" with "to the extent included in any".
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo's 'to the extent included in any' replacement stands in §1.6 (p-012) with no contradicting tracked change.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 1.12 the deletion of "Confidential Information (as defined herein),".
per_rubric.justification: The struck 'Confidential Information (as defined herein),' in the IP definition (p-018) remains deleted; no reinsertion.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 1.16 the deletion of "and is limited to, two components of Provider’s software-as-a-service offering “TalentFlow”, namely an AI-agent platform that performs the following tasks: (1) candidate material summaries for human review; and (2) interview note-drafting for human review.  TalentFlow does not enable autonomous decisions on the hiring or rejection of candidates, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking, filtering or scoring of candidates."
per_rubric.justification: The Services limitation text (two components, human review, no autonomous decisions) is reinstated and stands in §1.16 (p-022), with cmt-785 rejecting removal.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 2.3.1 the replacement of "performance of" with "connection with".
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo's 'connection with' replacement in §2.3.1 (p-031) is left intact with no contrary tracked change.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 4.1 the deletion of "or indirectly".
per_rubric.justification: 'directly or indirectly' remains in the §4.1 restrictions (p-039), so the deletion is effectively rejected, as cmt-787 states.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 6.4 the replacement of how Usage Data will be used with "Usage Data (i.e., aggregated, de-identified technical and operational data about access to and use of the Service) solely to develop, improve, support, and operate the Service. Provider will not include in Usage Data any information that identifies LargeCo, any LargeCo data subject, or any LargeCo Confidential Information. Provider will not share Usage Data with any third party other than (i) as permitted under this Agreement, or (ii) where the Usage Data has been aggregated and anonymized."
per_rubric.justification: LargeCo's Usage Data replacement text (aggregated, de-identified, solely to develop/operate) stands in §6.4 (p-053); AgentCo's cmt-789 accepts it.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 8.1 the re insertion of "and (ii) the disclosure does not include information that could identify any particular individual or device".
per_rubric.justification: The 'could identify any particular individual or device' disclosure limitation remains in §8.1 (p-057) as standing text.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 10.2 the deletion of "10.2.	Past-due undisputed amounts may bear a finance charge on the unpaid balance, accruing daily and compounding monthly, at the prevailing Federal Funds Rate (floored at zero) plus 1.5% per annum. Provider may suspend LargeCo’s access to the Service if any undisputed Fee remains past due, after providing LargeCo with written notice of the late payment. In any billing dispute, all undisputed amounts must be paid in full when due."
per_rubric.justification: The finance-charge and suspension language in §10.2 (p-063) is removed, and cmt-792 drops the finance charge instead of rejecting its deletion.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 13.1(e) the deletion of "as of the Effective Date, Provider does not appear on any U.S. government restricted-party list, and to its knowledge, none".
per_rubric.justification: The restricted-party sentence in §13.1(e) (p-075) is reinstated as an insertion, and cmt-791 restores it, so the deletion is not accepted.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 14, the deletion of "This Section 15 and Section 16.1(b), below, does not apply to any portion or component of the Service: (A) not developed by Provider, including Customer Data; (B) modified by anyone other than Provider where the alleged infringement relates to that modification; (C) combined with products, processes, or materials not approved by Provider in writing where the alleged infringement relates to that combination; (D) used by LargeCo after Provider has notified LargeCo of the alleged infringement or has provided modifications that would have avoided it; or (E) used in a manner inconsistent with this Agreement."
per_rubric.justification: The §15 exclusions carve-out text remains in place as a tracked insertion at p-097, so the deletion is effectively rejected.

per_rubric.criteria: Rejects in Section 17.1 the insertion of "and excluding Provider’s indemnification obligations".
per_rubric.justification: No 'and excluding Provider's indemnification obligations' language appears in §17.1 (p-104), so no rejection is made.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 17.2 the insertion of "breach of Confidentiality, or breach of the Data Processing Addendum".
per_rubric.justification: The 'breach of Confidentiality, or breach of the Data Processing Addendum' insertion does not appear in the §17.2 cap text (p-105).

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 17.2 the replacement of the cap being equal to the amounts paid in the 12 months preceding the cap with 3 times the amount of Service fees owed.
per_rubric.justification: §17.2 (p-105) still uses the 12-month fees cap; cmt-795 refuses the 3X cap, so the replacement is not accepted.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 18.4 changing the governing law from "California" to "Delaware".
per_rubric.justification: 'California' is struck and 'Delaware' inserted in §18.4 (p-110) with no contrary AgentCo change.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts the 18.5 deletion of the "Arbitration" clause.
per_rubric.justification: The §18.5 arbitration clause (p-111) remains deleted with no reinsertion, so the deletion is accepted.

per_rubric.criteria: Accepts in Section 2 of Exhibit A the replacement of "97.5%" with "99.5%"
per_rubric.justification: Exhibit A §2 (p-137) shows LargeCo's 99.5% change standing, and cmt-797 accepts it, though a stray inserted ']' remains.
